answer: Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, which means the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. The mesa receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a spiral seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. That is 26 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
